note: Tokens declared somewhere the scope that needs them cannot reach. FREEZE: a `:root` declaration that reads a re-scopable seed substitutes once on <html>, so a scope below it inherits the answer root gave — the cure is `--x: initial` with the formula at the call site (docs/TOKENS.md). REACH: a bare `var(--t)` on an element where --t computes to nothing, because --t is declared only under a selector that element is not inside. Every entry is DEBT and the list may only SHRINK; the gate fails on anything new. Keyed on the ARRANGEMENT and never on a frame, an element or a measured value — a pixel in the key makes every known entry read as new on a different renderer (preview/frame-overflow.baseline.json learned that the hard way). `seenOn` is where to go and look.
tracked:
gh#834 + gh#835 opened this list. Both are FIXED and neither is in it. gh#848 retired two more (--segmented-track-background, --segmented-item-selected-background: `initial` with their formulas at the call site; measured in Chromium with `.dark` on a <div> rather than <html>, the track went rgb(244,243,240) -> rgb(49,47,43)).
  WHY THIS LIST GREW 67 -> 88, WHICH IT IS NOT ALLOWED TO DO (gh#854). The 21 additions are not new defects and not a regression: the GATE widened. COLOUR_SEEDS was a hand-kept array of 18 names and the dark theme block re-declares 36, so everything bound to --muted-foreground, --secondary, --secondary-foreground, --popover-foreground or --warning was filtered out by the tier clause and had never reached this file. Those tokens were frozen the whole time; only the instrument was blind. The seeds are now DERIVED from foundation.css's dark block, so a role added there seeds this gate for free — the same move regen-generated.mjs makes for generators, and for the same reason: the header of check-frame-token-scope.mjs already recorded that a hand-kept list is how the --font-size-* ramp went unseen for three releases.
  AND THE RULE IS NOW ENFORCED. `--update-baseline` used to rewrite this file unconditionally while the note above claimed the list may only SHRINK — a rule in prose and not in code, which would have absorbed a real regression without a word. It now refuses to grow unless `--accept-growth` is passed, and that flag is for exactly one situation: you widened the gate, and you say so here.
  WHAT IS LEFT, AND WHAT IT IS. Every remaining FREEZE entry is a `:root` declaration that reads a seed docs/CUSTOMER-THEMING.md tells a consumer they may re-scope, so a [data-tenant] or .dark subtree that sets that seed will NOT move the knob. The colour half is the gh#687 shape and is the dangerous half (a frozen light surface under dark ink). The --radius-* and --shadow-* families are the same defect one tier over and are the obvious next tranche.
  NOT IN THIS LIST, ON PURPOSE: the ~230 component tokens that mirror a foundation step at :root (`--badge-font-size: var(--font-size-xs)`). They are frozen too, and they are the third tranche; see the tier clause in scripts/check-frame-token-scope.mjs for the measurement that kept them out of the gate rather than out of the truth.

intentional.REACH · backdrop-filter · --topbar-backd: gh#831 — the glass bar is OPT-IN and expresses its OFF state as an empty knob. `--topbar-backdrop-blur-size: initial` at :root, read BARE so `blur()` has nothing to substitute, the declaration is invalid at computed-value time, and the bar blurs nothing. A fallback here would make the glass the default. src/styles/__tests__/topbar-glass.test.ts asserts the absence of the fallback, so the two guards agree.
intentional.REACH · background-color · --topbar-back: gh#831 — the other half of the same opt-in. `hsl(var(--background) / var(--topbar-background-alpha))` with the alpha empty is invalid, so the bar paints no fill at all, which is the documented default. Setting the knob (e.g. 85%) is what turns the glass on.
intentional.FREEZE · --text-2xs ← --font-size-base: The `:root` copy Tailwind emits from `@theme inline` is frozen, and NOTHING reads it: the compiled `.text-2xs` / `.text-5xl` utilities INLINE the formula (`font-size:var(--font-size-2xs,calc(var(--font-size-base)/…))`), so rendered text resolves at the element and DOES follow a re-scoped `--font-size-base` (verified in preview/dist CSS, gh#965); no src/ CSS or JS reads `var(--text-2xs)`/`var(--text-5xl)`. Same state as `--text-xs`/`--text-sm`, already tracked above. The documented cure (make the :root copy `initial`) would turn a consumer's direct `var(--text-*)` read from silently frozen into silently WRONG — the 30.0.0 breaking class — so it is not applied.

intentional.REACH · --table-row-tone-surface · --sur: gh#866 hand-off, and this is a CUSTOM PROPERTY declaration — it paints nothing. With the brand `--surface-*` role unset it becomes guaranteed-invalid ON PURPOSE, and its one consumer (`.ui-table-row[data-tone]`) reads it as `var(--table-row-tone-surface, hsl(var(--table-row-tone-color) / var(--table-row-tone-wash-alpha)))`, so the derived wash applies. Measured in Chromium with the role unset (gh#965): destructive rows paint rgba(170,24,31,0.06), warning rows rgba(143,86,0,0.06) — the tone is visible, confirmed by screenshot.

intentional.REACH · -webkit-backdrop-filter · --app-: gh#831 pattern, the same opt-in the topbar pair above already records. `--app-shell-bar-backdrop-blur-size: initial` is the OFF state: read bare inside `blur()` it makes `-webkit-backdrop-filter` invalid at computed-value time, which computes to `none` — no blur, as the token's own declaration comment says. Only a glass theme (docs/themes/glassmorphism.css) turns it on. The gate's suggested cure is WORSE, measured in Chromium (gh#965): `blur(var(--x, 0px))` computes to `blur(0px)`, and ANY backdrop-filter other than `none` makes the element a containing block for `position: fixed` descendants — a fixed child moved from (0,0) to (100,200). A dropdown, tooltip or toast inside this surface would be trapped.
